local users = tool('list_users', {})
local dates = {"2026-06-15","2026-06-16","2026-06-17","2026-06-18","2026-06-19"}

-- fetch availability for every user/date
local busy = {} -- busy[date] = list of {s,e} in minutes since midnight UTC
for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
  busy[d] = {}
  for _, u in ipairs(users) do
    local a = tool('get_availability', { user_id = u.id, date = d })
    for _, iv in ipairs(a.busy or {}) do
      local function mins(t)
        local h, m = t:match("(%d+):(%d+)")
        return tonumber(h)*60 + tonumber(m)
      end
      busy[d][#busy[d]+1] = { s = mins(iv.start), e = mins(iv.end_) or mins(iv["end"]) }
    end
  end
end

local function overlaps(s1, e1, s2, e2) return s1 < e2 and s2 < e1 end

local result = nil
for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
  for start = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do
    local fin = start + 60
    local ok = true
    for _, iv in ipairs(busy[d]) do
      if overlaps(start, fin, iv.s, iv.e) then ok = false break end
    end
    if ok then
      local function fmt(m)
        return string.format("%02d:%02d:00Z", math.floor(m/60), m%60)
      end
      result = { start = d.."T"..fmt(start), ["end"] = d.."T"..fmt(fin) }
      break
    end
  end
  if result then break end
end

return { users = users, result = result }
